title: Copy a directory using ditto
summary: Use the `ditto` command to copy files and directories. It is often preferred over `cp` on macOS because it preserves metadata and handles special file types correctly.

steps.explain: Copy the contents of the source directory to the destination directory. If the destination exists, its contents will be overwritten by the source.

placeholders.name: SOURCE_DIR
placeholders.description: Path to the directory you want to copy

alternatives.explain: Copy while retaining original file permissions and resource forks (useful for preserving app bundles or specific metadata).
